products.title: Demco DM 7500 Gate Valve Repair Kit, 2″ — Minor & Major
products.focusKeyword: demco 2 inch gate valve repair kit
products.descriptionShort: 2″ repair kits for Demco DM 7500 mud gate valves — minor kit J025177-00274 and the major overhaul kit. OEM Cameron or interchangeable.
products.descriptionLong:
Repair kits for 2″ Demco DM mud gate valves. The minor kit holds the parts that wear in normal service; the major kit adds everything replaced at a full overhaul. Both rebuild the valve in the line — the bonnet comes off without cutting the valve out. We supply new parts: genuine Cameron (Demco) where you need OEM, or interchangeable aftermarket parts made to the same dimensions — say which on the RFQ.

Kits we have photographed at this size

MakeValve seriesKitKit number
DemcoDM 7500MinorJ025177-00274
DemcoDM 7500Major—

What is in each kit

DM 7500 minor kit: gate, seat insert, two body wear rings with their wear ring seals, bonnet seal and gate clip. DM 7500 major kit: the minor kit plus stem, stem vee packing with bushing, stem screw with bearings, secondary seal and housing seal. Some aftermarket minor kits add the stem packing; we list the contents on the quotation.

The minimum bore through a 2″ DM 7500 valve (wear ring ID) is 1.97 in, per Cameron's DM 7500 manual.

Also for 2″ DM valves

  • Demco DM Gate Valve Gate, 2″
  • Demco DM Gate Valve Seat Assembly, 2″, 2,000–5,000 psi
  • Demco DM 7500 Gate Valve Seat Insert, 2″
  • Demco DM Gate Valve Stem, 2″
  • Demco DM Gate Valve Stem Screw, 2″

Ordering

Give the valve size, series (DM 2000–5000 or DM 7500), trim and elastomer on your RFQ, with the Cameron part number or the number stamped on the old part if you have it, and whether you need OEM or interchangeable parts. We confirm lead time and documentation on the quotation.
products.seoTitle: Demco 2 in Gate Valve Repair Kit — DM 7500
products.seoDescription: 2 in Demco DM 7500 gate valve repair kits: J025177-00274. Minor and major kits, OEM Cameron or interchangeable. Request a quote.

faqs.question: Minor or major kit — which do I need?
faqs.answer: The minor kit covers a leak through the bore or a scored gate and seat, which is routine service. Take the major kit when the stem leaks, the valve is hard to turn or the stem screw bearings are worn, or at a scheduled overhaul.

faqs.question: Do I need to take the valve out of the line?
faqs.answer: No. Both kits are fitted with the valve in place: drain and isolate it, remove the bonnet, and change the parts. Cameron's DM 7500 manual says to fit new stem and bonnet seals whenever the bonnet assembly is worked on.

faqs.question: Are DM 2000–5000 and DM 7500 kits interchangeable?
faqs.answer: No. The two valves use different seats, gates and bonnet parts. Give the valve's size and working pressure, or its nameplate details, on the RFQ.

faqs.question: Are these parts supplied new?
faqs.answer: Yes. We supply new parts, genuine Cameron (Demco) or interchangeable aftermarket to the same dimensions, as you specify on the RFQ.

faqs.question: Does this seat fit a DM 7500 valve?
faqs.answer: No. The DM 7500 uses a different design: a ring-type seat insert that runs against two separate body wear rings. See our DM 7500 seat inserts for those valves.

faqs.question: Which elastomer should I choose?
faqs.answer: Buna-N (nitrile) is the standard for water- and oil-based drilling mud. Viton is chosen for higher temperatures and aromatic or aggressive fluids. State the fluid and temperature on the RFQ if you are unsure.

faqs.question: Which insert materials are there?
faqs.answer: Demco lists DM 2000–5000 seats with ductile iron, steel or 316 stainless inserts, each with Buna-N or Viton. Steel with Buna-N is the common drilling-mud seat.
